research_note: Curated from primary pages, abstracts and project descriptions. Books, recordings and code were not fully read, watched or executed. No verified future conference match is included in this pass.

resources.title: Rust on Cortex-R52
resources.why: Documents the libraries and examples released for the intermediate Arm processors discussed in the talk.

resources.title: aarch32: Rust support for Arm Cortex-R and Cortex-A
resources.why: Provides low-level processor access and runtime support to inspect after the ecosystem overview.

resources.title: Rust and ThreadX
resources.why: Explains why integrating Rust with an existing real-time operating system can be useful.
resources.caveat: Historical integration example; certification statements are tied to its publication date.

resources.title: The Embedded Rust Book
resources.why: Builds the no_std and peripheral vocabulary needed to compare embedded ecosystems.
resources.caveat: Introductory examples focus on microcontrollers rather than covering every Cortex-A or Cortex-R target.
